name: SAAS Properties
verdict: SAAS Properties is a family-owned UAE property developer founded in 2019 by Mohammad Bin Ahmad Bin Saeed Al Qassimi, with his son Ahmed Al Qassimi as CEO. Nothing found.
note: Upper-sleeve sponsor (serif 'S.A.A.S' wordmark) on Al Ain's 2026/27 home, away and third shirts, from the club's kit-launch photo (22 Jul 2026) and the club shop's product photos; SAAS is listed on the club's partners page and SAAS's own Instagram posts (April/May 2025) celebrated being a sponsor of Al Ain FC in 2024/25.
